name: BiasLens
tagline: Upload a trade log to see scores for overtrading, loss aversion and revenge trading, with explanations and coaching.

awards: National Bank of Canada Prize Track

problem: Retail traders lose returns to cognitive biases they do not recognise in their own behaviour.
solution: Computes behavioural features from a CSV of trades, scores three biases with a gradient-boosted model, explains each score with SHAP feature charts, flags the trades that triggered it and offers AI coaching.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload trades and expand a bias card to see which behaviours drove it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “National Bank of Canada Prize Track” among 77 submissions.
Explains predictions with feature attributions rather than only flagging trades.
Won a crowded sponsor challenge: many teams built bias detectors for the same brief.

lessons: In a crowded sponsor brief, explainability is what separates near-identical detectors.
